title: Commandite Partner Voting Ban and Minimum Fiscal Year
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Commandite partner voting ban
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the commandite partner (محمد) (شريك موصي) is not entitled to vote on the removal of the manager. FAIL if the note does not state that the commandite partner (محمد) is prohibited from voting on the removal of the manager.

criteria.title: Minimum first fiscal year
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the minimum first fiscal year is six months. FAIL if the note does not state that the minimum first fiscal year is six months.

criteria.title: Proposal below minimum
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that Khalid's proposal (five months) is below the minimum permitted period and is therefore not acceptable under the regulations. FAIL if the note does not state that Khalid's proposal (five months) falls below the minimum permitted period and is not acceptable under the regulations.

criteria.title: Commandite partner scope of restriction
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the restriction on the commandite partner's (شريك موصي) voting right covers specifically the matters of appointment and removal. FAIL if the note does not state that the restriction on the commandite partner's (شريك موصي) voting right covers specifically the matters of appointment and removal.
